title: Registration Study of Amyotrophic Lateral Sclerosis (ALS) in Mainland China
brief_summary: A multi-center registration study of natural history and clinical characteristics of ALS in mainland China
raw_criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* Clinical diagnosis of laboratory-supported probable, probable, or definite ALS according to EI Escorial diagnostic criteria
* Age: 18-70 years

Exclusion Criteria:

* Refuse to cooperate or reject the informed consent
study_population: Patients who meet the criteria will be enrolled from multi-centers in mainland China.
